Name: Auto Elixir
Author: Louupy
Description:
[b]Auto Elixir[/b] is a QOL mod that automatically consumes a Life Elixir from your inventory when your health drops below a configurable threshold. No more scrambling to find an Elixir in your inventory when your health is low. Particularly useful for those on controller (it has been tested on SteamDeck!)


[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Automatically consume a Life Elixir when health drops below your chosen threshold[/*]
[*]Configurable health threshold via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — choose from 10%, 25%, 40%, 50%, or 75% of your [b]maximum health[/b][/*]
[*]HUD notification showing how many Elixirs remain after one is consumed - toggleable with [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/*]
[*]HP threshold scales with your character! [/*]
[*]Enable or disable the mod at any time[/*]
[/list]
[b]
[b]Requirements:[/b][/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, but recommended - default is 25%)[/*]
[/list]
[b]
Installation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Download and extract the mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list][b]Note: This mod was made using Claude AI.  I am aware that people can feel very strongly on AI usage for mods. I am brand new to modding for Stardew and I am using Claude to help me with the process.[/b]
